ato.component.title: Avatar Texture Optimizer
ato.component.description: Analyses avatar meshes, rescales UV islands to a perceptual quality target, discards unused UV regions and repacks textures into atlases.
ato.quality.tier.tooltip: Higher presets preserve more detail and save less memory. Balanced is recommended for most avatars.
ato.quality.maximum.note: Maximum keeps every texture at its original resolution. Textures are still atlased, deduplicated and re-encoded.
ato.atlas.generate.tooltip: Combine textures into shared atlases. Disable to only rescale textures individually.
ato.atlas.padding.tooltip: Space between islands. Padding is computed automatically from atlas size and clamped to at least this value.
ato.atlas.npot.tooltip: Allows atlas sizes in steps of 64 px. Saves memory but is not supported by every compression format.
ato.whitelist.label: Excluded Objects
ato.whitelist.tooltip: Anything listed here is left completely untouched. Accepts textures, materials, renderers, meshes, animation clips or entire GameObjects.
ato.debug.verbose.tooltip: Writes detailed per-stage timings and decisions to the console.
ato.progress.title: Optimizing Textures
ato.report.noop: No textures were eligible for optimization.
ato.error.no-descriptor: Avatar Texture Optimizer must be placed on a GameObject with a VRCAvatarDescriptor.
ato.error.no-descriptor:description: This component analyses a whole avatar, so it must sit on the avatar root next to its VRCAvatarDescriptor.
ato.error.multiple-components: Only one Avatar Texture Optimizer component is allowed per avatar.
ato.error.multiple-components:descriptio: Multiple components would produce conflicting atlas layouts. Remove all but one.
ato.error.internal: Avatar Texture Optimizer failed unexpectedly. The avatar was left unmodified.
ato.warn.crunch: {0} uses Crunch compression and cannot be processed. It was left unchanged.
ato.warn.unreadable: {0} could not be read and was left unchanged.
ato.warn.uv-seam: {0} has UV islands crossing a tile boundary and was excluded to avoid visual errors.
ato.warn.uv-animated: {0} has animated UV properties and was excluded.
ato.warn.aao-uv: {0} uses a UV channel that Avatar Optimizer cannot evacuate. It was excluded.
ato.warn.mesh-renderer-uv: {0} is a MeshRenderer; UV channel evacuation is only supported for SkinnedMeshRenderer. It was excluded.
ato.warn.format-unsupported: {0} is not supported on {1}; falling back to an automatic format.
